summary: soispoke 的 keyed nonce（EIP-8250）合并，让一个 EIP-8141 发送方并行运行多条 nonce 序列，为无需信任的隐私协议解锁并发交易。lightclient 整理 EIP-8141 规范并合并。EIP-8130 加入规范验证器集合，并提交 owner 调用策略。EF 宣布清晰签名上线，目标是终结盲签。strkBTC 在 Starknet 主网上线。

items.title: 新 EIP：frame 交易的 keyed nonce
items.note: （soispoke）合并，即 EIP-8250：一个 EIP-8141 发送方可以运行多条相互独立的 nonce 序列，而不是单一线性队列，从而支持无需信任的隐私协议并发发送交易。
items.title_en: New EIP: Keyed Nonces for Frame Transactions
items.note_en: (soispoke), merged as EIP-8250: one EIP-8141 sender can run multiple independent nonce sequences instead of a single linear queue, so trustless privacy protocols can send transactions concurrently.
items.topic_en: Native account abstraction: EIP-8141, EIP-8250, EIP-8130

items.title: EIP-8141：frames 整理
items.note: （lightclient）合并，过去两个月规范改动频繁，这次在不大改功能的前提下提升可读性，并为批处理中被跳过的 frame 在收据里引入 `skipped` 状态 `0x3`。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: frames cleanup
items.note_en: (lightclient), merged. After two months of rapid spec changes, it improves readability without changing much functionality, and introduces a `skipped` receipt status `0x3` for frames skipped within a batch.

summary_en: soispoke's keyed nonces (EIP-8250) were merged, letting one EIP-8141 sender run multiple nonce sequences in parallel and unlocking concurrent transactions for trustless privacy protocols. lightclient cleaned up the EIP-8141 spec, and it was merged. EIP-8130 added a canonical verifier set, and owner call policies were submitted. The EF announced that clear signing is live, aiming to end blind signing. strkBTC went live on Starknet mainnet.
